verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation's own docs say developer packages, tools and runtimes are ready with a single command. It also ships container tooling, including a Container_Toolbox subvariant, and one user turned a laptop into a Python development workstation quickly. There is no evidence of preconfigured, framework-specific environment templates; setup appears to be per-package installation rather than turnkey stacks. Missing for 10: documented preconfigured environments or templates for specific frameworks and languages, detail on how Toolbox environments are provisioned, broader hands-on corroboration across languages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can quickly set up preconfigured development environments for popular frameworks and languages

citations.quote: All the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command.
Use the latest container tools from the Red Hat ecosystem. No setup required.
it became a full Python development workstation quickly
